Markets.title: Interest in Trump's meme coin dinner fades as $TRUMP sinks to record lows
Markets.summary: Interest in President Donald Trump's upcoming crypto gala dinner has dropped significantly, with only 185 holders of the $TRUMP token participating as the coin hits record lows. While the Trump family has earned billions from crypto ventures, many investors are facing substantial losses in the declining market.

Markets.title: Trump Media faces possible $1 billion debt repayment as stock nears record lows
Markets.summary: Trump Media & Technology Group faces a $1 billion debt repayment that has driven its stock to near-record lows and strained its financial health. Over half of the company's assets consist of volatile digital assets like cryptocurrencies.

Markets.title: Nvidia earnings spotlight shifts to leadership, AI financing after Huang exit
Markets.summary: Following CEO Jensen Huang's departure amid controversies, interim CEO Colette Kress must address Nvidia's leadership crisis and AI ecosystem impact. Investors are seeking clarity on revenue expectations and financing commitments in the upcoming earnings report.

Markets.title: Barclays lowers 2027 year-end target for S&P 500 index to 8,700
Markets.summary: Barclays lowered its 2027 year-end S&P 500 index target from 8,800 to 8,700 on Monday. The adjustment is driven by concerns that higher interest rates and tighter financial conditions will limit valuation growth.

Markets.title: US stocks: Summit shares drop after US FDA declines to approve lung cancer drug
Markets.summary: Summit Therapeutics shares fell after the US FDA declined to approve its lung cancer drug, ivonescimab, due to insufficient overall survival benefits in late-stage trials. Analysts are concerned about the decision's potential impact on similar treatments as investors await new trial results.

Markets.title: US stocks: Nasdaq slides over 1% as AI selloff deepens ahead of Nvidia earnings
Markets.summary: US stocks declined as an AI sector selloff deepened and Nvidia shares dropped following Jensen Huang's resignation. Additionally, new US regulations restricting China's access to advanced AI chips weighed on semiconductor companies and overall market confidence.

Geo-Political.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
Geo-Political.summary: Five European Union countries—Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands—have announced plans to establish a deportation center in Rwanda. The facility will serve as a "return hub" for individuals whose asylum applications in Europe have been rejected.

Geo-Political.title: Yemeni forces retreat to defend port city from Houthis
Geo-Political.summary: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces are redeploying troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait. They are moving these forces to protect the interim capital of Aden from Houthi advancement.

Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump has expressed support for a campaign urging Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as the company's chief executive officer. Several technology figures initiated the push to return the former boss to his position at the AI chip giant.
